goal: Widen PopDAM submission-lease reset to accept reason not_submitted with NULL http status and fixed provider_error category, and widen provider_definitive_rejection to HTTP 400/401/402/403/422/429, while preserving every other guard
prohibited_actions: No shared preview or production database write from this author session
No merge or manual production dispatch
Do not reset expired, ambiguous or provider-bound submissions
Do not change public.update_bulk_operation or its grants
assumptions: PopDAM calls not_submitted only when the worker failed before any provider POST; SQL cannot verify this external claim
PopDAM calls provider_definitive_rejection only after authenticating and parsing a definitive provider HTTP 4xx response
Only the existing guarded writer may issue the next receipt after the reset bumps the revision
stop_conditions: Any path that grants a receipt to a different caller without a fresh guarded claim
Any path that turns timeout, disconnect, 5xx or expired-lease ambiguity into resubmission
